verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes: Eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus.

verses.original: כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֧ה אֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּם־ בָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶתְכֶ֥ם שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ma·‘ă·śêh ’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer yə·šaḇ·tem- bāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ū·ḵə·ma·‘ă·śêh ’e·reṣ- kə·na·‘an ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem šām·māh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ū·ḇə·ḥuq·qō·ṯê·hem lō ṯê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt where you used to live and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan into which I am bringing you - You must not walk in their customs . . .
verses.literalPt: Não fareis segundo as obras da terra do Egito, em que habitastes; não fareis segundo as obras da terra de Canaã, na qual eu vos hei de introduzir; nem andareis segundo os seus estatutos.

verses.original: אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֧י תַּעֲשׂ֛וּ וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay ta·‘ă·śū wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay tiš·mə·rū lā·le·ḵeṯ bā·hem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Cumprireis os meus juízos e guardareis os meus estatutos, para neles andardes; eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām hā·’ā·ḏām wā·ḥay bā·hem ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Keep My statutes and My judgments for the man who does these things will live by them I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Guardareis, pois, os meus estatutos e os meus juízos; fazendo os quais, o homem viverá por eles: eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ שְׁאֵ֣ר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִקְרְב֖וּ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָ֑ה אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’îš ’el- kāl- šə·’êr bə·śā·rōw lō ṯiq·rə·ḇū lə·ḡal·lō·wṯ ‘er·wāh ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: None of . . . . . . you are to approach any close relative . . . to have sexual relations . . . I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Nenhum de vós se chegará àquela que lhe é próxima por sangue, para descobrir a sua nudez; eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛יךָ וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·‘er·waṯ ’im·mə·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh ’im·mə·ḵā hî lō ṯə·ḡal·leh ‘er·wā·ṯāh
verses.literal: You must not expose the nakedness of your father by having sexual relations with your mother She is your mother you must not have sexual relations with her . . .
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez de teu pai, isto é, a nudez de tua mãe. Ela é tua mãe; não descobrirás a sua nudez.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־ אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ê·šeṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh ‘er·waṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hî
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your father’s wife it would dishonor your father
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez da mulher de teu pai; é nudez de teu pai.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲחֽוֹתְךָ֤ בַת־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַת־ אִמֶּ֔ךָ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת בַּ֔יִת א֖וֹ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת ח֑וּץ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ă·ḥō·wṯ·ḵā ḇaṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’ōw ḇaṯ- ’im·me·ḵā mō·w·le·ḏeṯ ba·yiṯ ’ōw mō·w·le·ḏeṯ ḥūṣ lō ṯə·ḡal·leh ‘er·wā·ṯān
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your sister either your father’s daughter or . . . your mother’s daughter whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere
verses.literalPt: A nudez de tua irmã por parte de pai ou por parte de mãe, nascida em casa ou fora de casa, sim, a nudez dela, não a descobrirás.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֤ת בַּת־ בִּנְךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַֽת־ בִּתְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָ֑ן כִּ֥י עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ הֵֽנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ baṯ- bin·ḵā ’ōw ḇaṯ- bit·tə·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·leh ‘er·wā·ṯān kî ‘er·wā·ṯə·ḵā hên·nāh
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter for that would shame your family
verses.literalPt: A nudez da filha de teu filho; ou filha de tua filha, sim, a nudez delas, não a descobrirás; porque a sua nudez é a tua.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת בַּת־ אֵ֤שֶׁת אָבִ֙יךָ֙ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת אָבִ֔יךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ֖ הִ֑וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ baṯ- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā mō·w·le·ḏeṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’ă·ḥō·wṯ·ḵā hî lō ṯə·ḡal·leh ‘er·wā·ṯāh
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . . . . the daughter of your father’s wife born to your father she is your sister
verses.literalPt: A nudez da filha da mulher de teu pai, gerada por teu pai, ela é tua irmã, não descobrirás a sua nudez.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחוֹת־ אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה שְׁאֵ֥ר אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ă·ḥō·wṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh šə·’êr ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hî
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your father’s sister she is your father’s close relative
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez da irmã de teu pai; ela é parenta bem chegada de teu pai.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחֽוֹת־ אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּֽי־ שְׁאֵ֥ר אִמְּךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ă·ḥō·wṯ- ’im·mə·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh kî- šə·’êr ’im·mə·ḵā hî
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your mother’s sister for she is your mother’s close relative
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez da irmã de tua mãe; porque ela é parenta bem chegada de tua mãe.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחִֽי־ אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶל־ אִשְׁתּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְרָ֔ב דֹּדָֽתְךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ă·ḥî- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh ’el- ’iš·tōw lō ṯiq·rāḇ dō·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā hî
verses.literal: You must not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations with her . . . she is your aunt
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez do irmão de teu pai, não te chegarás à sua mulher; ela é tua tia.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת כַּלָּֽתְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֵ֤שֶׁת בִּנְךָ֙ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ kal·lā·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh ’ê·šeṯ bin·ḵā hî lō ṯə·ḡal·leh ‘er·wā·ṯāh
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your daughter-in-law She is your son’s wife you are not to have sexual relations with her . . .
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez de tua nora; ela é mulher de teu filho.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־ אָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’ê·šeṯ- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh ‘er·waṯ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā hî
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . your brother’s wife that would shame your brother
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez da mulher de teu irmão; é nudez de teu irmão.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אִשָּׁ֛ה וּבִתָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶֽת־ בַּת־ בְּנָ֞הּ וְאֶת־ בַּת־ בִּתָּ֗הּ לֹ֤א תִקַּח֙ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֔הּ שַׁאֲרָ֥ה הֵ֖נָּה זִמָּ֥ה הִֽוא
verses.transliteration: ‘er·waṯ ’iš·šāh ū·ḇit·tāh lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh ’eṯ- baṯ- bə·nāh wə·’eṯ- baṯ- bit·tāh lō ṯiq·qaḥ lə·ḡal·lō·wṯ ‘er·wā·ṯāh ša·’ă·rāh hên·nāh zim·māh hī
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with both . . . a woman and her daughter You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her . . . They are close relatives it is depraved
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez duma mulher e de sua filha; não tomarás a filha de seu filho, nem a filha de sua filha, para descobrir a sua nudez: elas são parentas bem chegadas; maldade é.

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח לִצְרֹ֗ר לְגַלּ֧וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֛הּ עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּחַיֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·ṯāh lō ṯiq·qāḥ liṣ·rōr lə·ḡal·lō·wṯ ‘er·wā·ṯāh ‘ā·le·hā bə·ḥay·ye·hā
verses.literal: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her . . . while your wife is still alive
verses.literalPt: Não tomarás uma mulher juntamente com sua irmã, de modo que lhe seja rival, descobrindo a sua nudez ao lado da outra durante a sua vida.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּנִדַּ֣ת טֻמְאָתָ֑הּ לֹ֣א תִקְרַ֔ב לְגַלּ֖וֹת עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- ’iš·šāh bə·nid·daṯ ṭum·’ā·ṯāh lō ṯiq·raḇ lə·ḡal·lō·wṯ ‘er·wā·ṯāh
verses.literal: You must not approach a woman to have sexual relations with her . . . during her menstrual period . . .
verses.literalPt: Não te chegarás a uma mulher para lhe descobrires a nudez, enquanto for impura em virtude da sua menstruação.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ אֵ֙שֶׁת֙ עֲמִֽיתְךָ֔ לֹא־ תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ֖ לְזָ֑רַע לְטָמְאָה־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- ’ê·šeṯ ‘ă·mî·ṯə·ḵā lō- ṯit·tên šə·ḵā·ḇə·tə·ḵā lə·zā·ra‘ lə·ṭā·mə·’āh- ḇāh
verses.literal: You must not lie carnally . . . with your neighbor’s wife and thus defile yourself with her
verses.literalPt: Não te deitarás com a mulher do teu próximo, para te contaminares com ela.

verses.original: וּמִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֥ לֹא־ תִתֵּ֖ן לְהַעֲבִ֣יר לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֧א תְחַלֵּ֛ל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miz·zar·‘ă·ḵā lō- ṯit·tên lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr lam·mō·leḵ wə·lō ṯə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- šêm ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech for you must not profane the name of your God I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não darás nenhum de teus filhos para os fazeres passar pelo fogo a Moloque, nem profanarás o nome de teu Deus; eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְאֶ֨ת־ זָכָ֔ר לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֑ה תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- zā·ḵār lō ṯiš·kaḇ miš·kə·ḇê ’iš·šāh tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh hî
verses.literal: You must not lie with a man as with a woman that is an abomination
verses.literalPt: Não te deitarás com o homem, como se fosse mulher; é uma abominação.

verses.original: וּבְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֛ה לֹא־ תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ֖ לְטָמְאָה־ בָ֑הּ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה לֹֽא־ תַעֲמֹ֞ד לִפְנֵ֧י בְהֵמָ֛ה לְרִבְעָ֖הּ תֶּ֥בֶל הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl bə·hê·māh lō- ṯit·tên šə·ḵā·ḇə·tə·ḵā lə·ṭā·mə·’āh- ḇāh wə·’iš·šāh lō- ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê ḇə·hê·māh lə·riḇ·‘āh te·ḇel hū
verses.literal: You must not lie carnally with any animal thus defiling yourself with it a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it that is a perversion
verses.literalPt: Não te deitarás com algum animal para te contaminares com ele; nem a mulher se porá diante dum animal, para se ajuntar com ele: confusão é.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בְּכָל־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֤י בְכָל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ נִטְמְא֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṭ·ṭam·mə·’ū bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh kî ḇə·ḵāl- ’êl·leh niṭ·mə·’ū hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî mə·šal·lê·aḥ mip·pə·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Do not defile yourselves by any of these practices for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you have defiled themselves
verses.literalPt: Não vos contamineis com nenhuma destas coisas, pois com todas elas são contaminadas as nações que eu hei de expulsar de diante de vós.

verses.original: וַתִּטְמָ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֶפְקֹ֥ד עֲוֺנָ֖הּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַתָּקִ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṭ·mā hā·’ā·reṣ wā·’ep̄·qōḏ ‘ă·wō·nāh ‘ā·le·hā wat·tā·qi hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇe·hā
verses.literal: Even the land has become defiled so I am punishing it for its sin and the land . . . will vomit out its inhabitants
verses.literalPt: A terra está contaminada; portanto, visito nela as suas iniquidades, e ela vomita os seus habitantes.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אַתֶּ֗ם אֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’at·tem ’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śū mik·kōl hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇōṯ hā·’êl·leh hā·’ez·rāḥ wə·hag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem
verses.literal: But you are to keep My statutes and ordinances and you must not commit any of these abominations neither your native-born nor the foreigner who lives among you
verses.literalPt: Vós guardareis os meus estatutos e os meus juízos, e não cometereis nenhuma destas abominações, nem o natural, nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós

verses.original: כִּ֚י אֶת־ כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔ל עָשׂ֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַתִּטְמָ֖א הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- kāl- hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇōṯ hā·’êl ‘ā·śū ’an·šê- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer lip̄·nê·ḵem wat·tiṭ·mā hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For the men who were in the land before you committed all these abominations and the land has become defiled
verses.literalPt: (porque todas estas abominações cometeram os homens da terra, que foram antes de vós, e a terra está contaminada).

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תָקִ֤יא הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּטַֽמַּאֲכֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָאָ֛ה אֶת־ הַגּ֖וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯā·qî hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ·ḵem bə·ṭam·ma·’ă·ḵem ’ō·ṯāh ka·’ă·šer qā·’āh ’eṯ- hag·gō·w ’ă·šer lip̄·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: So if you defile the land . . . it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you
verses.literalPt: Não suceda que a terra, sendo contaminada por vós, vos vomite também a vós, como vomitou a nação que foi antes de vós.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְנִכְרְת֛וּ הַנְּפָשׁ֥וֹת הָעֹשֹׂ֖ת מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh mik·kōl hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯū han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ hā·‘ō·śōṯ miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·mām
verses.literal: Therefore anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off . . . . . . from among his people
verses.literalPt: Todo o que cometer alguma destas abominações, sim, aqueles que a cometerem, serão cortados dentre o seu povo.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י לְבִלְתִּ֨י עֲשׂ֜וֹת מֵחֻקּ֤וֹת הַתּֽוֹעֵבֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשׂ֣וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- miš·mar·tî lə·ḇil·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ mê·ḥuq·qō·wṯ hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇōṯ ’ă·šer na·‘ă·śū lip̄·nê·ḵem wə·lō ṯiṭ·ṭam·mə·’ū bā·hem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you so that you do not defile yourselves by them I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Portanto, guardareis o meu mandamento, para que não caiais em alguns destes abomináveis costumes, que antes de vós foram seguidos, e para que vos não contamineis com eles: eu sou Jeová.
